summary.result: Specifically, POMS subfactors showed statistically significance improvements (p<.05) in Vigor, Tension, Depression, Anger, Confusion and TMDS (Total Mood Disturbance Score), as well as GDS-K subfactors exhibited statistically significance improvements (p<.05) in Lack of Vigor, Negative Cognition, Social Withdrawal & Anxiety and TS (Total Score).
summary.background: The evaluation utilized the Oculus Quest 2 and the CheerU VR program.
summary.method: The experiment was conducted for approximately 1 month in July 2024, with POMS and GDS-K administered before & after the VR program experience.
